t: A six-axis classroom robot arm programmed in Python or Ozobot Blockly.
steps: Find the ORA pages on the Ozobot website and read the FAQ.
Ask Ozobot for current pricing and a setup guide.
Ask IT to check the connection method and software needs.
Open Ozobot Classroom and review the standards-aligned lessons.
Set up the arm on a steady table with clear space around it.
Try a first program in Ozobot Blockly.
Move to Python after students know the basics.
